title: allow_http + credentials combination not warned at runtime
description: Config validation rejects http:// without allow_http=true, but when allow_http=true is explicitly set and credentials are configured, no warning is emitted. Azure backend emits tracing::warn! in this case. WebDAV with credentials and allow_http=true should also warn: credentials will be transmitted in plaintext. Add tracing::warn! in WebDavStore::new / WebDavBlockStore::new when allow_http=true and password is Some.
